lifestyle-health.excerpt: A Bhaskar investigation found antibiotics routinely prescribed for common colds and fevers without diagnostic tests, as experts warn India may be entering a 'post-antibiotic era.'
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Returning NRIs and travelers to India face elevated risks from drug-resistant infections during monsoon visits, while antibiotic stewardship practices common abroad remain weakly enforced across Indian hospitals and pharmacies.

lifestyle-health.title: Pope Leo XIV Declares Family the 'First School of Humanity' in Sweeping AI Encyclical
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The pontiff's 83-page teaching document 'Magnifica Humanitas' calls for an educational alliance to protect human dignity in the age of artificial intelligence.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The encyclical's call for AI regulation and its emphasis on family-centered education resonate with Indian diaspora parents navigating their children's growing dependence on digital technology.

lifestyle-health.title: Why Your 30s May Be the Most Important Decade for Protecting Your Brain
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Neurologists say the habits you form now — from managing cholesterol to prioritising sleep — can reduce dementia risk decades later, with new research showing 40 to 45 percent of cognitive decline is preventable.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: Relevant for Indian-American professionals in high-stress tech and finance roles, where long hours and sedentary work can accelerate cognitive risk factors.

food.excerpt: With retail onion prices crossing Rs 50 per kg in several cities, the Indian government is deploying special rail shipments and releasing buffer stocks ahead of the festive season.
food.nri_angle: Onion price volatility in India directly affects the cost of essential ingredients for diaspora families who regularly cook Indian cuisine or send remittances to relatives dealing with rising food costs.

food.title: IAS Couple Finds Insect in Salad at Upscale Gurugram Restaurant, Sparks Food Safety Probe
food.excerpt: Food safety officials inspected The House of Celeste and collected samples for laboratory testing after diners discovered a caterpillar in their vegetable salad.
food.nri_angle: NRIs visiting India frequently dine at upscale establishments in Gurugram and Delhi NCR, making food safety standards at premium restaurants directly relevant to diaspora travelers.

food.title: Punjabi Haveli to Open Fourth GTA Location as Vegetarian Indian Dining Expands
food.excerpt: The 100% vegetarian North Indian restaurant chain adds a Scarborough outpost to meet growing demand across the Greater Toronto Area.
food.nri_angle: Punjabi Haveli's expansion reflects booming demand for vegetarian Indian dining in the GTA, driven by the large South Asian diaspora community.

food.title: Indian Restaurant in West Sussex Joins Michelin Guide Within Six Months of Opening
food.excerpt: Chef Dayashankar Sharma's BAUJI in Worthing earns a Michelin Guide listing for its Rajasthani-inspired modern Indian menu, adding to the UK's growing recognition of regional Indian cooking.
food.nri_angle: BAUJI's rapid Michelin Guide recognition reflects the growing mainstream acceptance of regional Indian cuisine in the UK, where diaspora chefs are redefining how Indian food is perceived beyond the traditional curry house.

food.title: How a Husband-Wife Duo Built Victoria's First South Indian Restaurant Into a Two-Location Success
food.excerpt: Dosa Paragon, which started as a tiny storefront on Yates Street in Victoria, BC, has expanded to a second location and earned a loyal following for its crispy dosas and authentic South Indian cooking.
food.image_caption: A South Indian thali served at a restaurant. A husband-wife duo from Karnataka built Victoria's first South Indian restaurant and expanded to two locations.
food.nri_angle: A South Indian immigrant couple built Victoria's first dosa restaurant into a two-location success, now serving Onam sadya to connect Vancouver Island's Indian community to cultural traditions.

food.title: The Great Dosa Debate: Fork and Knife, Center or Side, and Why It All Matters
food.excerpt: A series of viral videos — from a retired officer cutting dosa with cutlery to a comedian's tactical breakdown of center vs. side eating — has reignited one of Indian food culture's most passionate arguments.
food.nri_angle: Indian Americans navigating cross-cultural dining face pressure to adopt cutlery norms for foods designed for hand eating; dosa technique debates resonate across the diaspora

food.title: Four Classic Sadya Recipes to Bring Kerala's Onam Feast to Your Table
food.excerpt: With Thiruvonam just days away on August 26, these traditional vegetarian recipes — cabbage thoran, cheera parippu, avial, and sambar — capture the essence of Kerala's grandest meal.
food.image_caption: A traditional Kerala Sadya served on a banana leaf. The elaborate vegetarian feast is central to Onam celebrations across the Indian diaspora.
food.nri_angle: Kerala diaspora worldwide can recreate the traditional Onam Sadya feast at home with readily available ingredients from Indian grocery stores.

travel.title: Inside Kerala's Spiral Coffee House: Laurie Baker's Architectural Gem That Looks Like a Giant Cake
travel.excerpt: The Indian Coffee House in Thiruvananthapuram, designed by British-born architect Laurie Baker, draws visitors with its spiraling brick ramp, no-window design, and affordable South Indian fare.
travel.image_caption: Architect Laurie Baker, the British-born designer whose spiral Coffee House in Thiruvananthapuram has become one of Kerala's most beloved landmarks.
travel.nri_angle: The Indian Coffee House is a nostalgic landmark for Keralite NRIs worldwide and sits steps from Thiruvananthapuram's central railway station, making it an essential stop for diaspora travelers visiting Kerala.

travel.title: India Drops Physical Boarding Pass Requirement for International Flights From September 1
travel.excerpt: The Bureau of Immigration will stop stamping boarding passes at all international airports, allowing travelers to use e-boarding passes on their smartphones instead.
travel.image_caption: An Indian airport terminal. India's aviation regulator has announced that physical boarding passes will no longer be required for international flights starting September 1.
travel.nri_angle: The change directly benefits millions of NRIs and OCI cardholders who regularly fly between India and their home countries, eliminating a long-standing friction point at departure.

travel.title: India Expands Air Cargo Transshipment Network, Targets 80% Growth on Key Routes
travel.excerpt: After a successful pilot on the Chennai-Delhi-Frankfurt corridor that cut transit times from 60 to 20 hours, India adds six new gateways including routes to London and Copenhagen.
travel.image_caption: India is expanding its air cargo transshipment network to reduce dependence on hubs in the Middle East and Southeast Asia, targeting 80 percent growth on key trade routes.
travel.nri_angle: Faster cargo connectivity between Indian cities and European diaspora markets; improved delivery times for NRI shipments to/from India

travel.title: Bengaluru Airport Slashes Departure Fees but Introduces Arrival Charges From September 1
travel.excerpt: AERA's new tariff order cuts domestic departure UDF by 45% to ₹300 while introducing a fee for arriving passengers for the first time at India's third-busiest airport.
travel.image_caption: Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru. The airport will reduce departure fees while introducing new arrival charges from September 1.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs flying into Bengaluru will face new arrival fees for the first time; departure fee cuts benefit outbound travellers but round-trip costs change

carousel.title: Sending Money to Parents in India? The Documentation Mistake That Triggers Tax Notices for NRIs
carousel.excerpt: Gifts from NRI children to parents are tax-exempt under Indian law, but incomplete records can lead to years-long disputes with the Income Tax Department — as one US-based NRI learned after a six-year tribunal battle.
carousel.nri_angle: Millions of NRIs routinely send money to parents in India, but most are unaware that missing documentation — not the transfer itself — is what draws Income Tax scrutiny and can trigger years of legal disputes.

carousel.title: New Zealand Moves to Ban Social Media for Children Under 16 With Steep Fines
carousel.excerpt: The proposed legislation would require platforms to verify users' ages and could impose fines of up to 10% of global revenue for non-compliance, joining a growing international movement.
carousel.nri_angle: The global trend toward social media age restrictions is relevant to Indian-American parents navigating digital safety for their children, and India's own discussions about implementing similar measures.
